## Setup and Package Loading
```{r setup, message=FALSE}

setwd("/Users/bishtananya/Desktop/Bioinformatics")
library(tximport)
library(DESeq2)
library(tidyverse)
library(pheatmap)
library(EnhancedVolcano)
```

```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# 
library(biomaRt)

# 1. Connect to the human Ensembl database (GRCh38 build)
# Note: This might take 15–30 seconds to establish a secure connection
mart <- useMart("ensembl", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")

# 2. Download the transcript IDs and their matching gene symbols
tx2gene <- getBM(
    attributes = c("ensembl_transcript_id_version", "external_gene_name"),
    mart = mart
)

# 3. Rename columns so tximport recognizes them automatically
colnames(tx2gene) <- c("tx_id", "gene_id")

# 4. Take a quick peek at your new mapping table
head(tx2gene)

```


```{r setup, message=FALSE}
# importing kallisto data into R

# 1. Tell R to look in your current working directory
dir <- getwd()

# 2. LIST ALL 8 OF YOUR EXACT SRR NUMBERS HERE:
samples <- c("SRR28816867", "SRR28816868", "SRR28816869", "SRR28816870", 
             "SRR28816871", "SRR28816872", "SRR28816873", "SRR28816874") 

# 3. Automatically construct the file paths to all 8 abundance.tsv files
files <- file.path(dir, paste0("result_", samples), "abundance.tsv")
names(files) <- samples

# 4. Run the tximport translator
txi <- tximport(
    files = files, 
    type = "kallisto", 
    tx2gene = tx2gene, 
    ignoreTxVersion = TRUE
)

```
